title: Crochet Heart Charm
name: Heart Charm
seoTitle: Crochet Heart Charm Pattern for Beginners (Free PDF)
description: Free crochet heart charm pattern for beginners: a small heart from a magic ring, sewn on a round white base with a looped border. Printable PDF download.
lead: A small heart sewn onto a round white base, with a looped border in the same colour as the heart. Quick and sweet as a bag charm.
yarn: Cotton yarn in red or pink and white

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn in red or pink (heart and border) and white (base)

rounds.text: Magic ring. ch 3, 3 tr, 4 dc, ch 2, 4 dc, 3 tr, ch 3, sl st. Pull the ring closed.
Magic ring, ch 2, 12 dc in the ring, sl st.
ch 2, 2 dc in each st, sl st.
(ch 3, skip 1 st, sl st in next st) around. Fasten off.

finishing: Sew the heart in the middle of the base.
